notes: No MCP tools expose rustre-fuzz-net functionality. Grep over crates/rustre-mcp-tools, crates/rustre-mcp-server, and wire_tools.rs returned no matches for fuzz_net/FuzzNet/NetFuzz.
The Rust crate exists (crates/rustre-fuzz-net/src/lib.rs) but is not surfaced through the MCP server (target/release/rustre-mcp.exe).
The Python validator at validation/validators/rustre-fuzz-net.py only contains a smoke test in __main__ (no parameterized test cases to forward via JSON-RPC).
Therefore no direct comparison was possible; match=false reflects an integration gap rather than a value mismatch.

mismatches_list.detail: rustre-fuzz-net public API (MessageDef, ProtocolDef, frame_u32_le, xor_checksum, add_checksum, CrashDetector, NetworkStateMachine, ProtocolModel, TlsFuzzer, ReplayEngine, etc.) has zero MCP wrapper tools.
